answer: One defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: an agent must lock collateral and build a verifiable history of useful work before it can transact at full trust. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes, like trying to fill an ocean with a quill one drop at a time, while honest agents grow slowly like a grove from proven roots. If an identity cheats, its stake is slashed and its history burned, so sybils stay expensive and unprofitable.
